title: Filter builder
description: Make a compound filter editable in place without a full settings panel.
useCase: Make a compound filter editable in place without a full settings panel.
reducedMotion: Live system preference disables decorative motion; all controls remain usable. Keyboard actions settle immediately.
limitations: Synthetic result rows visualize filter state; no data query is performed.
look: Pale blue-grey page with a white card: a bordered filter chip, dashed add button, grey skeleton rows and a dropdown popover with coloured status dots.
motion: Pressing the chip fades in the popover as it scales up from 0.98 at its top-left origin and drops 4 px (180 ms ease-out); picking a status closes it.
adapt: The popover is CSS on `.filter-popover` toggled by `data-open` (`opacity 150ms ease, transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)` from `translateY(-4px) scale(0.98)`). Replace the status options, `assignee` toggle and placeholder `results` with real filter fields; keep `inert` and Escape-to-close.
